summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Iteration 9 features: Department hierarchy with stage assignment, enquiry close/reopen, notifications, pending stages report, and PO fields removal. All backend APIs (100% - 15/15 tests) and frontend features working correctly.
passed_tests: Admin login with correct credentials (admin@example.com / admin123)
GET /api/departments returns list of departments
GET /api/departments/{id}/hierarchy returns stage hierarchy
PUT /api/departments/{id}/hierarchy saves hierarchy with stages and assigned users
GET /api/enquiries returns paginated list
PUT /api/enquiries/{id}/close closes enquiry (admin only)
PUT /api/enquiries/{id}/reopen reopens closed enquiry (admin only)
GET /api/notifications returns user notifications
GET /api/notifications/unread-count returns unread count
PUT /api/notifications/read-all marks all notifications as read
GET /api/reports/pending-stages returns pending stages grouped by user
POST /api/enquiries creates enquiry without PO fields (po_no, po_received_date, qty_received)
GET /api/stages returns all stages
GET /api/users returns all users
Notification bell present in header with dropdown
Department Master page shows two panels: department list + stage hierarchy
Clicking department opens its stage hierarchy panel
Can add stages to department hierarchy via dropdown
Can assign users to stages in hierarchy
Can reorder stages with up/down arrows
Can remove stages from hierarchy with X button
Save Hierarchy button persists hierarchy to backend
Enquiry create form does NOT have PO No, PO Received Date, Qty Received fields
Enquiry create form HAS Fabric Received field
Enquiry detail/edit form does NOT have PO No, PO Received Date, Qty Received fields
Enquiry detail/edit form HAS Fabric Received field
Enquiry detail page shows status badge (Open/Closed)
Admin can close an enquiry via Close button
Admin can reopen a closed enquiry via Reopen button
Reports page has Pending Stages tab
Pending Stages report shows users with pending work
seed_data_creation: Added 'Strike off Receipt date' stage to Sales department hierarchy with Admin user assigned for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 9 features fully tested and working: 1) Department hierarchy - two-panel layout on /departments page, click department to see/edit its stage hierarchy, add stages via dropdown, assign users to stages, reorder with arrows, remove with X, save persists to backend. 2) Enquiry close/reopen - admin can close/reopen enquiries, status badge shows Open/Closed. 3) Notifications - bell icon in header, dropdown shows notifications, mark read/all read works. 4) Pending stages report - new tab in Reports page shows pending work by user. 5) PO fields removed - po_no, po_received_date, qty_received removed from create/edit forms, fabric_received kept. Existing stages: Strike Off Receipt Date, CAD Ready Date, Design No, S-Off Status, Test Select Stage, Test Stage, Test Stage 2. Sales department now has 1 stage in hierarchy (Strike off Receipt date with Admin assigned).
